backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, feedback/rating storage, and access-controlled CRUD operations with admin and user permission checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that carries forward the feedbackCounter and initializes a new empty mechanicRegistrationsStore list during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (NavigationDrawer mechanic link, FloatingCallButton removal, MechanicRegistrationPage creation, etc.) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Google AdSense/Search Console verification, preconnect hints for ICP endpoints, and a LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema for QuickRepair Mahipalpur.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component with pathname-based routing that renders the main site, admin, booking, booking history, and mechanic registration pages, with FloatingCallButton removed and FloatingWhatsAppButton retained.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a text description of QuickRepair and a 2x2 grid of highlight cards (response time, verified pros, pricing, coverage) using a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Password-protected admin dashboard that lets admins view/delete users and feedback, and manage services and mechanic registrations via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Booking form section that requires Internet Identity authentication; on submission it posts form data to FormSubmit and shows a success overlay with a sound effect.
frontend/src/components/BookingSuccessOv: Full-screen portal overlay that displays an animated SVG checkmark and 'Booking Confirmed' message, auto-dismissing after 2.8 seconds.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section displaying phone, email, working hours, WhatsApp CTA, service area list, and an embedded Google Map in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with nine questions about QuickRepair's services, rendered with animated expand/collapse transitions and a fade-in on scroll.
Displays a feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched from the backend, and a form for submitting new star-rated feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Renders a fixed floating call button linking to the QuickRepair phone number with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat for booking a service.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with the QuickRepair logo, navigation links, a 'Book Online' button, copyright info, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with the QuickRepair logo, navigation drawer, Internet Identity login/logout, and a profile modal that opens when a logged-in user has no profile.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with an animated headline, tagline, CTA buttons for booking and calling, and trust-indicator badges.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Displays a three-step 'How It Works' process (Book, Arrive, Solved) with icons, connector lines, and a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A slide-in mobile navigation drawer that highlights the active section via scroll spy, shows nav links, and conditionally renders Booking History for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A full-screen semi-transparent backdrop component used to close the navigation drawer when clicked on mobile.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form for collecting and submitting a user's name, phone number, and service area to register their profile via the useRegisterUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a single repair service with its icon, description, starting price, and a 'Book Online' button that navigates to the booking page.
Renders the services section by fetching services from the backend and falling back to hardcoded services if none are returned, displaying them in a responsive grid of ServiceCards.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar displaying key trust indicators (happy customers, response time, star rating) with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling CSS fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend interactions including feedback, user profiles, admin checks, bookings, services, and mechanic registrations, with delayed query initialization for performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by listening to scroll events and comparing section offsets against the current scroll position.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS variables for the dark theme, and declaring custom animations for fade-ins, service card hovers, and a GPay-style booking success overlay.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BookingHistoryPage.ts: Page that displays a logged-in user's past bookings sorted newest-first, with authentication gating and individual booking cards showing date, time, service, address, and phone.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that requires Internet Identity authentication, submits form data to FormSubmit via fetch, and shows a GPay-style success overlay with a chime on completion.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationP: Mechanic registration form page with client-side validation that submits data via a mutation hook and displays a GPay-style success overlay with a portal on successful submission.
frontend/src/utils/playSuccessSound.ts: Utility that uses the Web Audio API to play a short C-E-G major chord arpeggio as a success chime, silently failing if the API is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (brand, surface, semantic), fonts, shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the dark-themed frontend.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot for the QuickRepair service platform, documenting existing features, known issues (admin panel auth errors, missing service/registration data), and architectural notes about theming and form submission.
